blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —Manila Water releases its December desludging schedule for selected barangays in the East Zone of Metro Manila and Rizal, helping households maintain properly functioning septic tanks during the holiday season. The water and wastewater service provider is encouraging customers in scheduled areas to avail of the service before their septic tanks reach full capacity. Regular desludging helps prevent septic tank overflow, foul odors, and the contamination of surrounding soil and waterways, which may pose risks to public health and the environment.
